items.title: Nick Brignola interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, July 28, 1997
items.q: I discussed this with Buddy DeFranco at one time... I talked to Buddy DeFranco... You know who showed me the best fingerings? [INTERVIEWER] Marshall Royal?

ctx.x: Yeah. I had a real good sound. In fact my grandfather always referred to it as “the voice.” He always used to say in broken Italian, “you have a-the voice — the sound.” Whatever that meant. In later years I guess I kinda got the message. Because if you hear me play clarinet, I do have some kind of a classical sound in a sense, and I never studied. I mean that was the sound I heard all the time. I discussed this with Buddy DeFranco at one time and he had the same kind of background really, and grew up as a little…
the conductor never knew. Maybe he did know, I don’t know. Now that I’m older I think that guy knew but he wanted me in the band.
